svg.aria-label: How the repos connect: General_Research holds the sources that AsteroidCatalog, spacecost and economicspace cite. AsteroidCatalog releases feed asteroid-belt-gradient, which builds the paper, and economicspace, which also installs spacecost, quietlaunch and quietqueue, cites the starred-repos audit, and ranks mining targets by profit.
